messages:
Sam: Need a compact deliverable for next week's benchmark push. Scope: hero (1200x628), 3 social tiles (1080x1080), single explainer slide (16:9 SVG + PNG), and a gated one-pager (A4 + mobile 800x1200). Extra asks: two messaging variants for A/B (developer-first vs procurement pitch), and a short PR-friendly blurb for the release notes. Deadline: first comps Tue noon.
Amira: I'll take visual lead. Quick decisions: tone for dev variant = punchy/technical, procurement = trust + SLA. Any hard numbers to show or just relative deltas?
Sam: Use relative deltas on social  avoid absolute claims. One-pager can show selective numbers but add footnote: "Based on internal Redwood Inference testing; results may vary by workload." Legal already confirmed.
Jules: Routing: hero CTAs should be [Register] -> /events?utm_source=web&utm_campaign=bench_launch and [Get benchmark] -> gated form collecting name/company/email/role. Hidden field campaign=bench_q3. Also add a Calendly CTA for enterprise leads.
Nate: Accessibility & export: ensure 4.5:1 contrast for body text, alt text lines in Figma for every image, and GIFs <500KB. Provide light/dark safe variants. Export names: bench_q3_hero_1200x628.png, bench_q3_tile_1080x1080_v1.png, bench_q3_onepager_A4.pdf. Drop to marketing-exports/bench_q3/.
art-bot: Brand kit: https://drive.redwood/brand/kit  color tokens, type scale, logo lockups. Auto-validate on export. Recommended hero safe zone: 48px.
Amira: Plan: wireframes Mon 10am, comps Tue noon, final assets Thu AM. Will include A/B copy slots and a 1-line PR blurb placeholder. Will post Figma link when frames are up.
Sam: Also need short social copy for both variants (<=140 chars) and 3 alt-text lines per microtile. I'll draft copy and drop into this thread by EOD. Thanks! :thumbsup:
